_doc: The schools (流派) (design/combat/spell-and-combat-spec.md §5.1, §7, §8; build item N-5.1). A school says how you cast: each spell names its school in data/spells.json (`school`), and each road takes a school (data/world/lives.json roads). schools: name, power, Spheres, casting act, and the rule it bends (only `alignment` is built). ranks: a school's ladder, with the Practice gained on its spells this life that each rank needs (`at`); a rank below the best you held in an earlier life comes `echo` times faster. outside: spells of a school that isn't this life's cost `trained` more Aether and wind-up if you hold a rank in it (or held only Initiate before), `never` more if you never trained in it, and nothing extra once an earlier life took it to `free_rank` (Adept). alignment (Astral Rite): stand still `still_s` before you begin a spell of your school and it gets `range_k` range.

astral_rite.name: Astral Rite
astral_rite.act: A chant read from a star chart
astral_rite.blurb: Stand still a breath before you cast: the spell reaches further.

spark_artifice.name: Spark Artifice
spark_artifice.blurb: Spells made at a bench into charges, thrown with no wind-up and no Aether.
